visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a grey t-shirt and grey pleated skirt, stands in an indoor hallway with a wooden screen. She points her left hand towards a dark wooden valet stand that has two small black horse figurines on its top shelf. A hand enters from the right holding a yellow and blue HahaTai microphone. (2) Close-up shots show the two miniature black horse statues in detail, resting on the dark wood of the furniture under bright indoor lighting. (3) The scene transitions to a kitchen and living area with white brick walls. The woman continues to speak excitedly, using expressive hand gestures. A man in a black tank top and a black New Balance cap is standing next to her, holding a smartphone. (4) The man in the black cap holds his smartphone out in front of him, conducting a speakerphone call. A stylized circular graphic of a man with purple hair appears as a floating overlay on the screen to represent the caller. (5) Another person in a green baseball cap and black t-shirt is seen standing nearby, reacting with shock and laughter. The group is gathered around a wooden kitchen counter. (6) Intercut frames show a black and white stylized image of a person in a pilot suit, then cut back to the group laughing hysterically. (7) The man in the black cap continues the phone conversation while smiling broadly. The lighting remains consistent and bright throughout. (8) The man ends the call by tapping the screen and waves a hand towards the camera as the group concludes their interaction.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @HahaTai. [Subtitle]: 你還有發現這兩個嗎. (2) [Subtitle]: 這是什麼. (3) [Subtitle]: 這是納豆的馬. 保佑工作的. (4) [Subtitle]: 過年的時候去你家. (5) [Subtitle]: 玩那個射龍門的時候. (6) [Subtitle]: 他來我家然後把東西給你. (7) [Subtitle]: 他其實照理來講只給我一個. (8) [Subtitle]: 好像有一隻不知道是誰的. (9) [Subtitle]: 於是大家決定 call out 給納豆. (10) [Subtitle]: 我發現他家有兩隻馬是你送他的. (11) [Subtitle]: 我應該送一隻馬啊. (12) [Subtitle]: 原來我家那隻馬就是你偷的. (13) [Subtitle]: 那我為什麼沒有. (14) [Subtitle]: 我有送 RJ 啊. (15) [Subtitle]: 所以另外一隻是 RJ 的. [Variety]: 屁啦. (16) [Subtitle]: 因為那個馬是要放在家裡的客廳的一個方位. [Slogan]: 豆媽媽人設翻車現場. (17) [Subtitle]: 我想問一下, 納豆也有來我家過, 為什麼我沒有拿到一隻馬? (18) [Subtitle]: 數量有限. (19) [Variety]: 喔!! [Subtitle]: 沒有資格拿到一匹馬. (20) [Subtitle]: 如果拿到兩隻馬的話, 會不會太嚴重. (21) [Subtitle]: 會業力引爆嗎. (22) [Subtitle]: 可能會工作太忙碌. (23) [Subtitle]: 蠻辛苦的. (24) [Subtitle]: 那隻馬繁殖了. [Subtitle]: 我們晚安.
